page.content:
Gouki — the Satsui no Hadou killer who murdered his own master.

How Akuma connects

  • Character: Gouken — Akuma struck Gouken down with the Raging Demon.
  • Character: Ryu — Akuma hunts Ryu as a test of the Satsui no Hadou.

What is Akuma?

Akuma is Gouken's brother, the Ansatsuken heretic who killed Goutetsu with the Raging Demon and now hunts Ryu as a test of the killing intent.

Key threads lead to Gouken and Ryu.
